shared_elements: low relief carved in tan/buff stone
wing or feather-like forms rendered with repeated parallel elements
horizontal band of repeated units running across the surface
justification: Both are buff-stone low reliefs that combine a horizontal band of repeated units with wing/feather-like forms and a small circular disc, and both show creatures in strict profile. But A is a single large, densely detailed figure with finely incised, regimented feather and bead rows, while B distributes several small, rounded, summarily modelled animals across registers on an irregular pillar face, so the manner of cutting and the compositional logic differ almost completely.
